pages.title: Streak Penalty
pages.text:
Eating the same food in a row applies a $(#e05252)Streak Penalty$(). Three meals of plain bread back to back? The third gives noticeably less grain nutrition than the first.

This stacks with food family diminishing returns to strongly discourage single-food diets.

pages.title: Breaking the Streak
pages.text:
Eating any $(bold)different food$() resets your streak immediately. You do not need to eat from a different group — just a different item.

The streak counter is visible in the food tooltip when it is active, so you always know when you are about to take a penalty.
